integrity: The universal claim is supported by a symbolic lower-bound argument using lower-set slices, explicit retractions, and Stong-core noncontractibility, together with a principal-open upper bound. The included finite verifier checks the mechanism only on representative examples and is not used to extrapolate the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes every base is nonempty and noncontractible and every cap has at least two points.
No classification is claimed for products of arbitrary finite spaces or capped spaces with contractible bases.
Finite computational checks are supplementary; the quantified theorem rests on the symbolic proof.
title: Multiplicativity of LS-category for products of capped finite spaces
